segments.name: Hygiene, Health and Consumable Adhesives
segments.description: Manufactures and supplies adhesives for assembly, packaging, converting, nonwoven, hygiene, health and beauty, flexible packaging, graphic arts and envelope markets.
segments.evidence: The Hygiene, Health and Consumable Adhesives operating segment manufactures and supplies adhesives products in the assembly, packaging, converting, nonwoven, hygiene, health and beauty, flexible packaging, graphic arts and envelope markets.

segments.name: Engineering Adhesives
segments.description: Provides high-performance adhesives to transportation, electronics, clean energy, aerospace and defense, textile, appliance and heavy machinery markets.
segments.evidence: The Engineering Adhesives operating segment provides high-performance adhesives to the transportation, electronics, clean energy, aerospace and defense, textile, appliance and heavy machinery markets.

segments.name: Building Adhesive Solutions
segments.evidence: The Building Adhesive Solutions operating segment manufactures and provides specialty adhesives, sealants, tapes and application devices for commercial building roofing systems, heavy infrastructure projects, road/highway transportation applications, telecom/5G utilities, industrial LNG plants, building envelope applications, HVAC insulation systems, performance woodworking and insulating glass.

revenueModel.text: Manufacturers in consumer goods, construction and industrial markets pay the company for adhesives, sealants and specialty chemical products, delivered directly or through distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are delivered directly to customers primarily from our manufacturing and distribution facilities, with additional deliveries made through distributors.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the company sold its North America Flooring business, previously part of the Construction Adhesives operating segment.
changes.evidence: As of the beginning of fiscal 2025, we reorganized our operating segments by selling our North America Flooring business, previously part of the Construction Adhesives operating segment

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the company combined its Insulating Glass, Woodworking and Composite businesses with Construction Adhesives Roofing and Building Envelope and Infrastructure businesses to form the Building Adhesive Solutions operating segment.
changes.evidence: combining our Insulating Glass, Woodworking and Composite businesses, previously part of the Engineering Adhesives operating segment, with Construction Adhesives Roofing and Building Envelope and Infrastructure businesses to form the Building Adhesive Solutions operating segment
